summary.text: Paul E. Krizek is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 16th District, which covers part of Fairfax County, and has served since 2016.
Krizek sits on the House committees on General Laws; Privileges and Elections; Appropriations; and Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources.

paragraphs.text: Paul E. Krizek was born in Washington, DC, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Krizek's education as University of Virginia (B.A., 1984) and Catholic University of America, Washington, DC (J.D., 1987).
The profile gives Krizek's occupation as non-profit executive.

Krizek's listed memberships and affiliations include St. Luke's Episcopal Church; Mount Vernon at Home (board member); Mount Vernon Lee Chamber of Commerce; Virginia State Bar; District of Columbia Bar; Fairfax County Redevelopment and Housing Authority (former commissioner).
